notes.title: 500 SALES MILESTONE!!! + Player Survey
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796587/28dee2a18f5a0e70eb7158e862703840b53b5044.png[/img]

That's right!! 500 sales!! Can you imagine that?! And that's not counting Itch.io players, review codes or playtesters - 500!!! I can't believe it!!

I'm eternally lucky and thankful for every single person who helped me get this far - friends, family, web mutuals, and work acquaintances, everyone who gave the game a shot in its infancy, everyone who ever tweeted about it or made a YouTube video, anyone who ever told a friend they thought it was cool - you guys are all rockstars.

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796587/e0f483184c437e8ae212fbe0ac1ce9a4d069bc9b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796587/07fa985cfffa9b2589658ac2d116661173715d3b.jpg[/img]

Since SomnaBuster's launch, I've been working on another game - a boss rush called 'Disaster Arms - Impact Project B.A.H.N.'. Conceptually, it's a game in the spirit of Treasure's Alien Soldier, though the core gameplay combines elements I've used in both Cycle Chaser H-5 and SomnaBuster. I don't have a lot to share about it at the moment, but I can promise development is rolling smoothly. With luck, it should be the first of many SomnaBuster follow-ups to come.

Lastly, I've created a survey for SomnaBuster players. It should take 3 minutes to fill out, I'd really appreciate if everyone could take a moment out of their day to record their responses.

Survey Link: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfXABRuKh-Dmzfkf7a0RaBMmdwFPQLmo2hxYQnuT4_4zkNIqA/viewform?usp=dialog]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfXABRuKh-Dmzfkf7a0RaBMmdwFPQLmo2hxYQnuT4_4zkNIqA/viewform?usp=dialog[/url]

Here's to another 500!

-PD CGT (David)

notes.title: PLAYSTATION CONTROLLER PLAYERS!! TURN OFF STEAM INPUT!!
notes.notes:
HI!!! Did you know Steam architecture is vague and arcane and all that fun stuff?

I'll keep it short - because we don't have Playstation button icons in the demo yet, Steam thinks it doesn't support Playstation controllers at all. So it defaults to Steam Input. And Steam Input doesn't work.

So DUALSHOCK and DUALSENSE players - please please please PLEASE!!!! Get your controller working again by turning off Steam Input!!

I will be fixing this and the 1000 other problems... eventually-ish-erson. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796587/e0d24389580516f63acb810cef0cb13c77369be7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796587/346a5532b0555fad0bfa7c2c749978b7dd8225b9.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: NEXT FEST DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
[i][b]NEXT FEST IS HERE!!!!! YO!!!!! VIDEOGAMES!!!!![/b][/i]

It's so exciting to share SomnaBuster with a new and growing community. To celebrate, I've updated the demo with all the quality of life changes from my most recent builds - AND, [b]you can now play preview versions of [u]Stage 2-1[/u] and [u]3-1[/u] from the final game![/b] So even if you've already played the demo, there's all the more reason to go back :)

Metrics-wise, I'd also like to announce that SomnaBuster has over 500 wishlists! I'm extremely grateful for everyone's interest in the game!! But we're still fighting to get this number even higher - SO, PLEASE, share this game with your friends! Wishlist it, and tell them to wishlist it, too!

Thanks for so much support,

-PD (David)
